26:2: Those are the verses of the clear Book.
26:3: Perhaps you will almost destroy yourself because they do not become believers.
26:4: If We will, We can send down upon them a sign from the sky, so their necks bend to it.
26:5: No new reminder comes to them from the Rahman without them turning away from it.
26:6: Indeed they denied, the news of the things they ridiculed will come to them.
26:7: Did they not look at the earth, how We grew in it from every beautiful pair?
26:8: Indeed in that is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:9: And indeed your Rabb, surely He is the Exalted in Might, the Most Merciful.
26:10: When your Rabb called to Moses: Go to the wrongdoing people.
26:11: The people of Pharaoh, will they not beware?
26:12: He said: My Rabb, indeed I fear that they will deny me.
26:13: My chest becomes tight and my tongue does not loosen, so send to Aaron.
26:14: They have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
26:15: He said: By no means! Go with Our signs. Indeed, We are with you, hearing.
26:16: So both of you go to Pharaoh and say: indeed, we are the messenger of the Rabb of the worlds.
26:17: Send the Children of Israel with us.
26:18: He said: Did we not raise you among us as a child, and did you not remain among us for years of your life?
26:19: And you did that deed of yours, and you are of the ungrateful.
26:20: He said: I did it then, while I was of those who strayed.
26:21: When I feared you, I fled from you. My Rabb granted me judgment and made me one of the messengers.
26:22: And that favor is something you reproach me with, by enslaving the Children of Israel.
26:23: Pharaoh said: And what is the Rabb of the worlds?
26:24: He said: The Rabb of the heavens, the earth, and what is between them, if you are of certain knowledge.
26:25: He said to those around him: Do you not hear?
26:26: He said: Your Rabb and the Rabb of your earliest forefathers.
26:27: He said: Indeed, your messenger who was sent to you is certainly a madman.
26:28: He said: If you reason, He is the Rabb of the east, the west, and what is between them.
26:29: He said: If you take a deity other than me, I will surely make you of the imprisoned.
26:30: He said: Even if I have brought you something clear?
26:31: He said: Bring it, if you are of the truthful.
26:32: Thereupon he threw his staff, and it became a manifest serpent.
26:33: And he drew out his hand, then it was pure white to the onlookers.
26:34: He said to the eminent ones around him: Indeed, this is a learned magician.
26:35: He wants to drive you out of your land with his magic, so what do you command?
26:36: They said: Postpone him and his brother, and send gatherers to the cities.
26:37: Let them bring you every learned magician.
26:38: Thus the magicians were gathered at the appointed time of a determined day.
26:39: It was said to the people: Are you the ones who are gathered?
26:40: They said: We hope that if the magicians overcome, we will follow the magicians.
26:41: When the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh: If we are victorious, is there indeed a reward for us?
26:42: He said: Yes, and then you will surely be of the near ones.
26:43: Moses said to them: Throw what you are going to throw.
26:44: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said: By the might of Pharaoh, indeed we, we are the victors.
26:45: Thereupon Moses threw his staff, and it immediately began swallowing what they fabricated.
26:46: Thus the magicians were thrown down prostrating.
26:47: They said: We have believed in the Rabb of the worlds.
26:48: The Rabb of Moses and Aaron.
26:49: He said: Did you believe in him before I gave you permission? Indeed, he is your chief who taught you magic. Soon you will know. I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.
26:50: They said: No harm, indeed to our Rabb we will return.
26:51: Indeed we hope that our Rabb will forgive us our mistakes because we are the first of the believers.
26:52: We revealed to Moses: Set out with My servants by night, because you will be pursued.
26:53: Pharaoh sent gatherers to the cities.
26:54: Indeed, these are a small group.
26:55: Indeed, they are those who enrage us.
26:56: And indeed, all of us are vigilant.
26:57: Thus We brought them out from gardens and springs.
26:58: And from treasures and a noble station.
26:59: Just like that, and We made the Children of Israel inherit it.
26:60: Then they pursued them at sunrise.
26:61: When the two groups saw each other, the companions of Moses said: 'Indeed, we are overtaken.'
26:62: He said: No, never! Indeed, my Rabb is with me, He will guide me.
26:63: We revealed to Moses to strike the sea with your staff. Thereupon the sea parted, and each separated part became like a great mountain.
26:64: Then We brought the others near as well.
26:65: We saved Moses and all those who were with him.
26:67: Indeed in that is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:68: And indeed your Rabb, surely He is the Exalted in Might, the Most Merciful.
26:69: And recite to them the news of Abraham.
26:70: When he said to his father and his people: 'What do you worship?'
26:71: They said: 'We worship idols and we remain devoted to them.'
26:72: He said: Do they hear you when you call?
26:73: Or do they hear you when you call, or do they benefit you or harm you?
26:74: They said: No, but we found our fathers doing thus.
26:75: He said: Have you seen what you have been worshipping?
26:77: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Rabb of the worlds.
26:78: The One who created me, it is He who guides me.
26:79: The One who feeds me and gives me drink.
26:80: And when I become sick, He heals me.
26:81: The One who causes me to die, then brings me to life.
26:82: The One who I hope will forgive my mistake on the Day of Judgment.
26:83: My Rabb, grant me judgment and join me with the righteous.
26:84: And grant me a tongue of truthfulness among the later generations.
26:85: And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Delight.
26:86: And forgive my father, indeed he is of those who strayed.
26:87: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected.
26:88: The Day when neither wealth nor sons will benefit.
26:89: Except the one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.
26:90: Paradise has been brought near for the possessors of taqwa.
26:91: Hell was brought out into view for the deviators.
26:92: It is said to them: Where are the things you used to worship?
26:93: Besides Allah. Do they help you or help themselves?
26:94: So they and the deviators were tumbled into it.
26:95: And all the soldiers of Iblis together with them.
26:96: And they say while disputing therein:
26:97: By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error.
26:98: When we equated you with the Rabb of the worlds.
26:99: And none made us go astray except the criminals.
26:100: Thus there are no intercessors for us.
26:102: They say: If only we had a return, so that we would be among the believers.
26:103: Indeed in that is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:104: And undoubtedly, your Rabb, He is the Aziz, the Rahim.
26:105: The people of Noah denied the messengers.
26:106: When their brother Noah said to them: "Will you not fear?"
26:107: Undoubtedly, I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
26:109: And I do not ask you for any reward for it. My reward is only upon the Rabb of the worlds.
26:110: So fear Allah and obey me.
26:111: They said: Shall we believe in you? Those who follow you are the lowest people.
26:112: He said: I have no knowledge of what they used to do.
26:113: Their account is only upon my Rabb, if you perceive.
26:114: And I am not going to drive away the believers.
26:115: I am only a clear warner.
26:116: They said: O Noah, if you do not desist, you will surely be of the stoned ones.
26:117: He said: My Rabb, undoubtedly my people have denied me.
26:118: So judge between me and them with an opening (judgment) and save me and the believers who are with me.
26:119: Thereupon We saved him and those with him by carrying them in the loaded ship.
26:120: Then We drowned those who remained behind.
26:121: Undoubtedly in this there is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:122: And undoubtedly, your Rabb, He is the Aziz, the Rahim.
26:123: The people of Ad denied the messengers.
26:124: When their brother Hud said to them: Will you not fear?
26:125: Undoubtedly, I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
26:126: So fear opposing Allah and obey me.
26:127: And I do not ask you for a reward for it, my reward is only upon the Rabb of the worlds.
26:128: Do you build a sign on every high ground, amusing yourselves in vain?
26:129: And do you take palaces, hoping that you will abide eternally?
26:130: And when you seize, you seize like tyrants.
26:131: So fear Allah and obey me.
26:132: And fear the One who helped you with the things you know.
26:133: He extended to you blessings and sons.
26:135: Undoubtedly, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.
26:136: They said: 'It is equal to us whether you have admonished or have not been of those who admonish.'
26:137: This is nothing but the custom of the ancients.
26:138: And we are not to be punished.
26:139: Thus they denied him, so We destroyed them. Undoubtedly in this there is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:140: And undoubtedly, your Rabb, surely He is the Mighty, the Most Merciful.
26:142: When their brother Salih said to them: Will you not fear Allah?
26:143: Undoubtedly, I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
26:145: I do not ask you for a reward in return for this. My reward is only upon the Rabb of the worlds.
26:146: Will you be left secure here?
26:148: And crops and date palms whose spathes are soft.
26:149: You carve out houses skillfully from the mountains.
26:151: And do not obey the command of the extravagant.
26:152: Those who cause corruption on the earth and do not set things right.
26:153: They said: You are only of the bewitched.
26:154: You are only a human being like us; if you are of the truthful, bring a sign.
26:155: He said: 'Here is a she-camel. She has a right to drink, and you have a right to drink on a determined day.'
26:156: And do not touch her with harm, lest the punishment of a tremendous day seize you.
26:157: Thereupon they hamstrung her and became regretful.
26:158: Thereupon the punishment seized them. Undoubtedly in this there is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:159: And undoubtedly, your Rabb, He is the Mighty, the Most Merciful.
26:160: The people of Lot denied the messengers.
26:161: When their brother Lot said to them: Will you not fear Allah?
26:162: Undoubtedly, I am a trustworthy messenger for you.
26:163: So fear Allah and obey me.
26:164: And I do not ask you for a reward in return for this, my reward is only upon the Rabb of the worlds.
26:165: Do you come to the males of the worlds?
26:166: And leave what your Rabb created for you of your wives? Rather, you are a people who transgress the bounds.
26:167: They said: 'O Lot, if you do not desist, you will definitely be of those driven out.'
26:168: He said: 'Undoubtedly, I am of those who detest your deed.'
26:169: My Rabb, save me and my family from what they do.
26:170: Thus We saved him and his family altogether.
26:171: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
26:173: And We rained down upon them a rain. How evil was the rain of those who were warned.
26:174: Undoubtedly in this there is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:175: And undoubtedly, your Rabb, surely He is the Exalted, the Most Merciful.
26:176: The companions of the Wood denied the messengers.
26:177: When Shuayb said to them: Will you not fear Allah?
26:178: Undoubtedly, I am a trustworthy messenger to you.
26:179: Fear opposing Allah and obey me.
26:180: And I do not ask you for a reward in return for this, my reward is only upon the Rabb of the worlds.
26:181: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
26:182: And weigh with the straight balance.
26:183: And do not deprive people of their goods and do not act corruptly on the earth as corrupters.
26:184: And fear Him who created you and the former generations.
26:185: They said: "You are only of the bewitched."
26:186: And you are only a human being like us, and we think you are of the liars.
26:187: If you are of the truthful, make a fragment from the sky fall upon us.
26:188: He said: My Rabb is the Best Knower of what you do.
26:189: Thereupon they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the shadow seized them; undoubtedly it was the punishment of a tremendous day.
26:190: Undoubtedly in this there is a sign, and most of them were not believers.
26:191: And undoubtedly, your Rabb, surely He is the Mighty, the Most Merciful.
26:192: Undoubtedly, it is the revelation of the Rabb of the worlds.
26:193: The trustworthy spirit brought it down.
26:194: Upon your heart, so that you may be of the warners.
26:196: And undoubtedly, it is in the scriptures of the ancients.
26:197: Did it not become a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel know it?
26:198: And if We had sent it down to one of the non-Arabs
26:199: And he had recited it to them, they would still not have been believers in it.
26:200: Thus We insert it into the hearts of the criminals.
26:201: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
26:202: So that it comes upon them suddenly while they do not perceive.
26:203: Then they say: 'Are we to be granted respite?'
26:204: Were they seeking to hasten Our punishment?
26:205: Have you seen, if We let them enjoy for years?
26:206: Then that which was promised to them came to them.
26:207: That which they were made to enjoy did not avail them anything.
26:208: We did not destroy any city but that it had its warners.
26:209: As a reminder, and We were not unjust.
26:210: And the devils did not bring it down.
26:211: And it does not suit them, nor are they able to do so.
26:212: Indeed, they have been removed far from hearing.
26:213: So do not call upon another god along with Allah, otherwise you will be among the punished.
26:214: And warn the closest of your relatives.
26:215: Lower your wing to the believers who follow you.
26:216: If they disobey you, then say: Indeed, I am free from what you do.
26:217: And put your trust in the Mighty, the Rahim.
26:218: Who sees you when you stand,
26:219: And your turning about among those who prostrate.
26:220: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
26:221: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
26:222: They descend upon every sinful slanderer.
26:223: They give ear, and most of them are liars.
26:224: And the poets—the deviants follow them.
26:225: Do you not see that they wander bewildered in every valley?
26:226: And they say the things that they do not do.
26:227: Except those who believe, do righteous deeds, remember Allah much, and take revenge after being wronged. Those who do wrong will soon know to what place of return they will return.
